axisDefinition: Volume-equivalent ellipsoid; the axes are the stated ratios with Z as the spin axis. With unit ratios this is a sphere.
measurement: Thermal infrared diameter 9.2 ± 1.0 km with a 0.02 albedo
scaleQualification: The published effective nucleus radius is used as a volume-equivalent display radius. This is an explicit scale convention, not a measured volume or set of physical axis lengths.
qualification: Smooth parameter-based approximation of an unresolved nucleus. Radar shows a strongly non-spherical nucleus a few kilometres across (Harmon et al. 1989); no axis ratio is adopted here. No local shape features, concavities, surface textures, coma or tail are claimed.
